svg.title: Unseen speakers: which digit was said, and which digit DTW heard
svg.desc: A ten by ten confusion matrix of DTW digit recognition on speakers that are not among the templates, with the number of clips in every cell. Most of the 300 clips per digit lie on the diagonal; the off-diagonal cells show which digits are mistaken for which.
svg.text: Unseen speakers: which digit was said, and which digit DTW heard
